watch.summary: The streamer reacts with shock and hype to pro Valorant player LOUD Erde's dominant scoreboard stats.

beats.what: Streamer calls out Erde's 11-3 stat line.
Streamer asks in disbelief where LOUD found this player.
Streamer exclaims again at the 11-2 score.
Streamer holds his forehead in amazement.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: Where did they find this dude?
watch.why: The clip functions as esports hype and disbelief rather than intentional comedy. It relies on the viewer understanding Valorant match context and scoreboard stats to appreciate the moment.
